ui.control: toggle / set a setting (meeting retention is owner-only)
Connect your services: open one service's card, its secure field focused

not_for_laya.reason: Connectors, accounts and keys are owner-only.
Opens a Windows settings page on the owner's own press; the Locks lines themselves are read by opening the section.
Choosing local AI only is the owner's press on Connect your services; by voice, "connect local AI" opens that card.
A test sends the stored key to its provider, so it is the owner's press on the card the voice opened.
Adding an MCP server runs a program or reaches a new address as the owner; owner-only, on the screen.
Measure now runs the PC hard, so it is the owner's press in Settings > Voice; by voice, ask_friday queues it for when the owner is away.
Not a router tool: local_voice_readiness is outside the full voice contract, and a test pins it out of the router. Voice asks it through ask_friday.
Switch back or keep cloud, once: the owner's own answer, on the card or by voice (ask_friday, local_voice_readiness answer); not a router tool.
Just this call or always: asked at every switch to cloud voice; by voice via ask_friday, local_voice_readiness, on the owner's own words only.
The interruption limit, quiet-hour times and Focus Assist are the owner's to loosen; by voice Laya can only quiet things (quiet until morning).
The report card shows the owner's own words and is served to the owner only; by voice, 'what have you learned?' is the laya_learning summary.
Undo or forget of one learned item is the owner's control over their own data; Laya never runs it, and the voice 'forget that' needs the owner's own words.
Reset, roll back and wipe of what Laya learned are the owner's controls (voice: 'reset', 'go back to last week'); a wipe is a card only a screen click approves.
Only the owner can confirm a choice the deeper mind made; Laya never confirms her own teacher (decision 3).
Learn now starts a visible Local AI queue job the owner asked for; it also runs by itself when idle, on AC power, with the vault open.
Loosening a learned threshold is the owner's decision, per head, by a click on the screen card (decision 15); Laya can never loosen herself.
Seeing the notice that Laya learns from corrections is the owner's own acknowledgement.

notes.text: Meeting retention (meeting_audio_retention, meeting_text_retention, meeting_text_retention_days) and whether meetings are searchable from the Library (meeting_archive) are the owner's own choices, set in Privacy & Data and the Meetings view; none is a voice-settable key or has a verb, and the archive's yes is taken only from a click on the screen.

The Gemini Live options row 'Trim what each call carries' sets voice_live_trim (off, shadow, on). It is a settings-panel row, not one of the audited UI actions, so it has no verb here. Laya reaches it by voice through the call's own tools: 'use fewer tools' and 'give me everything' are in resources/voice_session_phrasings.json (more_tools, internal gate, ring 1). Changing the mode itself stays the owner's choice in the panel.
